sources.snippet: JapanRailwaysimLLM is a 7.9 billion parameter language model developed by galakenya, finetuned from unsloth/gemma-4-E4B-unsloth-bnb-4bit. This model was trained using Unsloth and Huggingface's TRL library, achieving 2x faster finetuning. It is designed for general language tasks, leveraging its Gemma-4 base for efficient processing within a 32768 token context window.
